description: Gather every lantern, then reach the door. Click an adjacent raft in full interaction; use the direction buttons in simplified interaction. Solid spans connect nearby rafts; each deliberate request settles its half-second crossing before the next choice, and the rafts remain stable while you decide. Leaving lights a glaze fuse; revisiting never renews it. Turn the kiln samples to inspect this batch's glaze lifetimes before planning a return. Discovered stamps stay visible and inspection does not advance the decision clock. Dark gallery faces hide cracks but their outlines and recent motion remain visible. One broken span, collapsed landing or occupied raft, or incomplete seal ends this episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.
